Privacy Policy for CorruGo

Last Updated: November 26, 2026

CorruGo is built by Mohd Arsh (CartoniQ) as a free/commercial app. This SERVICE is provided by CartoniQ at no cost (or as a paid app) and is intended for use as is.

1. Information Collection and Use

CorruGo is designed to be an offline-first application. We do not collect, transmit, or store your personal data on any external servers.

  • Local Data: All your calculations, saved orders, and preferences are stored locally on your device using an encrypted database (Room).
  • No Account Required: You do not need to create an account to use this app.

2. Third-Party Services

The app may use third-party services that may collect information used to identify you.

  • Google Play Services: Used for core Android functionality.
  • Google AdMob: If the app displays ads, AdMob may collect device identifiers and usage data to serve personalized ads. You can opt-out of personalized ads in your Android device settings.
  • Google Play Billing: If you purchase the premium version, transactions are handled securely by Google Play. We do not store your payment information.

3. Log Data

We do not collect log data or crash reports on our own servers. If the app crashes, standard Android OS crash logs are stored locally on your device.

4. Security

We value your trust in providing us your data. Because the app is offline-first, your data stays on your device. We recommend keeping your device secure with a PIN or biometric lock.

5. Children’s Privacy

These Services do not address anyone under the age of 13. We do not knowingly collect personally identifiable information from children under 13.

6. Changes to This Privacy Policy

We may update our Privacy Policy from time to time. Thus, you are advised to review this page periodically for any changes. We will notify you of any changes by posting the new Privacy Policy on this page.

7. Contact Us

If you have any questions or suggestions about this Privacy Policy, do not hesitate to contact us at:
